source_prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a rocky shoreline meeting a sandy desert with a large orange pyramid in the background. A woman in a flowing green and purple medieval dress and wide hat stands on tide pools holding a glowing orange orb. A silver knight stands on the beach.
